about: The example house behind /r/example and the landing page (SPEC 2.1, 5.1): a 3,500 VA postpaid home in Yogyakarta that spends about Rp1,200,000 a month and runs air conditioning in the daytime, with someone home on weekdays. The pin is the city centre, inside the 0.5° cell (-7.75, 110.25) whose NASA POWER series is bundled in data/sun-fallback/yogyakarta.json. The usable fraction is the assumption set's default (roof.usableFraction).
